notes.title: Devlog - What has changed since the last beta test?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38133474/d0511debc586f8680c331b69037d8d8d6610fe44.jpg[/img]

It's been about a month since the last beta test.  Here's a summary of all the changes.  Thanks to lots of feedback I had a pretty big todo list of things to fix and improve.  First I focused on the feedback and bugs then I improved player customization.

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] New fonts that are more readable.
[*] The game will let you know if your version is out of date.
[*] Improved grenades.
[*] Added UI icons that lead you towards the closest ammo factory and armory.  Players had trouble finding ammo factories.
[*] Less screen shake.
[*] Smarter auto power cabling.
[*] Upgrades to buildings are now much better.  Upgrade those turrets!
[*] Buffed farms.
[*] Right mouse button can be used to select things.
[*] Game ID is now hidden by default.  Better for streamers.
[*] Confirmation prompt when quitting the game.
[*] Keyboard shortcuts for building.
[*] Added some tooltips to help new players.
[/list]

[h2]BUGS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the fonts.  Many languages had missing characters.  All the characters should now be included in the fonts.
[*] Can no longer select and upgrade the enemy team's buildings.
[/list]

Plus many more bug fixes and improvements that aren't listed.

[h2]BALANCING[/h2]
Balancing this game is really tough but it should be much better now.  In public games it now scales based on the number of players.  Also the different difficulties are balanced better by adjusting health and damage instead of only how many drones were being sent.

[h2]TRANSLATIONS[/h2]
If you would like to help out translating the game please get in touch with me.  The easiest way is Discord.  [url=https://discord.gg/R2nX8T8]https://discord.gg/R2nX8T8[/url]

[h2]NEW SHIPS[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38133474/55376c40585288a3259ef71ec44fe89dc0edb0ea.jpg[/img]

Two new ships have been added.  They can be purchased in the game at the armory.  The frigate is a tank and the destroyer is a really fun fast and nimble ship.  Also ships now grow in size as you upgrade them.

[h2]NEW PASSIVE ABILITIES[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38133474/ea72c5b3b18f7db12806713faf116be06c7b007c.jpg[/img]

In addition to buying main weapons and alt weapons you can now buy passive abilities.  My favorite are the side shields shown below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38133474/09a8b95c606a48b86864e9c303097ec417cb4691.jpg[/img]

[h2]GRAPHICS AND PERFMORMANCE[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38133474/ee128277eb1b62bec8ff5ed70f57ceed7a148f6c.jpg[/img]
Performance should be better and graphics for clouds and islands are improved.  Not only do the clouds render faster but now look much better.

The next beta test starts this Thursday.  See you there!

notes.title: The Next Beta Test will be April 15th - 19th
notes.content:
Next beta test will be 5 days from April 15th - 19th.  If you want to be notified when it starts sign up for the newsletter at https://www.getrevue.co/profile/ennogames

Lots of changes have been made since the last playtest.  
[list]
[*] The fonts have been updated to be sure that all languages have no missing characters.
[*] Many bugs have been fixed and small improvements have been made.
[*] Hotkeys have been added. 
[*] Two new ships can be bought at the armory.  The destroy ship is fast and nimble and can turn very quickly.  The frigate ship is a tank.
[*] Passive abilities have been added. 
[*] Directional icons added to the UI help you find the nearest ammo factory and armory.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Test 1 Complete
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who played during the beta test.  

[h2]STATS[/h2]

The weekend started with 6,162 people signed up.  According to the Steam page analytics 77% of the visitors were from China and 5% from the US.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38133474/79cdfa7b8e39929ff971d15bc443776119c3a0e0.jpg[/img]

When I started letting players in Friday morning I had no idea what to expect.  The game had never been tested with more than 7 players and I had no idea how many of the 6,162 would show up.  In the end 840 people played and the game peaked at 27 concurrent players.

[h2]BUGS[/h2]

Many bugs were found.  Thanks for all the reports.  There was one really bad bug that kept crashing the servers.  It didn't leave any errors in the logs so it was really hard to track down.  I spent most of the weekend trying to figure it out and am glad to say I finally know what the issue is and how to fix it.  

[h2]FUTURE PLANS[/h2]

Soon I'll be going through all the feedback and making a huge todo list.  Also this week I'm going to look into crowdsourcing the translations.  Multiple people reported that the current ones form Google Translate were not great.  After the bugs are fixed and the feedback is addressed I'm going to work on the ships and how the upgrades work.  Adding more ways to upgrade your ship and maybe even different ships.

[h2]THE NEXT BETA TEST[/h2]

The next beta test will probably be in about a month.  In that one I hope to have all the issues addressed and a few new features.

Again, thanks for playing!  See you again in a month I hope!
